messages:
maya: Quick thread — landing page + battlecard for next week's inference webinar. Need: one crisp bench line, two LP hero hooks, and a dead-simple lead routing payload. Can we lock before EOD? :hourglass:
rachel: I'll run a compact bench (hosted vs dedicated) for chat 2k ctx and embeddings batch64. p50/p95 + cost/1k tokens. ETA 2:30pm.
tori: I'll capture warm/cold tails and add a note about prefix caching behavior. Will flag anything surprising.
sam: Routing suggestion: emit three fields from the form -> webinar_flag, geo, intent. Rules: hot -> AE assign; warm -> SDR sequence + one-call; cold -> nurture drip. Keep it JSON.
jordan: I can implement hidden inputs and POST JSON to /api/webhook/lead-route. Test payload example:
```
{"webinar_flag":"true","geo":"NA","intent":"hot"}
```
Need final keys.
leo: For the battlecard, I'll draft top-3 objections vs cloud AI platforms and infra-only vendors with 1-line rebuttals each. Will add a short competitor matrix.
maya: Hero hooks I like: A) "Production-first inference: predictable latency, lower unit cost" B) "One serving path: hosted → dedicated → private" Feedback?
rachel: Use conservative quantifiers. Maybe change A to "Reduces unit cost while keeping latency predictable" and we'll reference the appendix.
tori: Add a short callout: "Automatic fallbacks keep apps online during capacity spikes" — good signal vs managed endpoints.
sdr-ops-bot: Reminder: update SDR playbook + Marketo field mappings by 09:00 tomorrow.
maya: OK locking: routing keys webinar_flag/geo/intent, hero lines adjusted per Rachel, Leo to draft objections. Ill assemble battlecard and drop for review at 4:30. If no blocking notes we'll push LP + webhook to staging tonight. :rocket:
